details: The Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting saw a dramatic shift towards a more hawkish monetary policy under new Chair Kevin Warsh. While interest rates were held steady at 3.50%-3.75%, the updated "dot plot" revealed a significant change in outlook, with the median year-end rate projection for 2026 jumping to 3.8% from 3.4% in March. This effectively eliminated expectations for rate cuts and introduced the possibility of rate hikes, with nine out of eighteen committee members now expecting at least one increase before December. This unexpected hawkish pivot triggered approximately $2 trillion in losses across traditional markets, including stocks and gold, and led to an immediate decline in cryptocurrency prices, with Bitcoin dropping 2-4% to around $63,850-$64,400 and Ethereum falling 2.5-3.5% to trade near $1,730-$1,750. The removal of forward guidance by Warsh signals a new era where markets will react more directly to incoming economic data.
title: Fed's Hawkish Pivot Shakes Crypto Markets

details: Beyond the Federal Reserve's hawkish signals, the cryptocurrency market has been experiencing sustained pressure from weak ETF inflows and broader global market trends. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded significant net outflows, signaling institutional de-risking ahead of policy uncertainties. Bitcoin dipped below $63,000 as a global sell-off in technology stocks and semiconductor shares dragged down broader markets, including the South Korean Kospi index and Nasdaq 100 futures. The overall crypto market saw broad declines, with Bitcoin down 3.73% and Ethereum down 5.44% in the past 12 hours. These factors collectively contribute to a risk-off environment for digital assets.
title: Crypto Market Declines Amid ETF Outflows & Tech Sell-off

details: Geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding stalled U.S.-Iran negotiations, have added to market uncertainty, with crypto markets absorbing risk from these developments. Looking ahead, investors are keenly focused on upcoming economic data releases, including US inflation data (CPI) and flash PMI data for major economies like the US and Eurozone. These indicators are expected to drive further volatility across global risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, as markets seek clearer signals on the economic trajectory and future central bank actions.
title: Geopolitical Risks & Key Data to Influence Crypto Direction
